ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT& DECLARATIONOFCOVENANTSANDRESTRICTIONS THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT & DECLARATION December, 2016, by and between 186 MANHATTAN ASSOCIATES, LLC a New York limited liability company, with offices at 2056 Fifth Avenue, Unit 5B, New York, New York liability company, with offices at 2056 Fifth Avenue, Unit 5B, New York, New York 10035 ("Air Parcel Owner") (Lower Parcel Owner or Air Parcel Owner, each, an “Owner” and collectively,"Owners"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Lower Parcel Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 139 in Block 1521 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, for the County of New York (the “Tax Map") and as and by the street address of 186 East 93rd Street, New York, New York, more particularly described in Schedule “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Existing Parcel") and of all buildings and improvements presently located thereon (the “Existing Building"; the Existing Building and any building that may hereafter be constructed in replacement in whole or·in part of the Existing Building with the Retained Development Rights (hereafter defined) in accordance with this Agreement are referred to herein as the "Lower Parcel Building"); WHEREAS, immediately after recording this Agreement, Lower Parcel Owner will subdivide the Existing Parcel into two parcels of land constituting two separate tax lots consisting of a parcel below a limiting plane (the “Limiting Plane") located at an elevation of one hundred and forty one and 18/100 feet (141.18') above the Datum Level (hereafter defined) (the “Lower Parcel") (the Lower Parcel Building together with the Lower Parcel are sometimes referred to hereinafter collectively as the “Lower Development Parcel"), more particularly described in Schedule “B” annexed hereto, and a parcel above the Limiting Plane (the “Air Parcel") and the Excess Development Rights (hereafter defined), more particularly described in Sehedule"C"annexedhereto; WHEREAS,upon completion of the subdivision, the fee for the Air Parcel and the Excess Development Rights will be transferred and conveyed to Air Parcel Owner, and, upon such transfer and conveyance, Air Parcel Owner shall be the owner of (a) fee simple title to the Air Parcel (the Lower Parcel and the AirParcel are sometimes referred tohereinafter collectively (as hereafter defined); WHEREAS, the Existing Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereafter defined), than is now available for use on the Existing Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that, after taking into account the floor area currently used by the Existing Building, Excess Development Rights are available for transfer to and utilization on another tax lot that is part of the same zoning lot as the Existing Parcel;
